name: Stream Flow Enhancement Program (SFEP)
summary: California state grants for projects that enhance stream flows for fish and wildlife, including wet meadow, floodplain and riparian restoration, invasive plant removal, water transactions and flow gauging.

status.quote: WCB is now accepting pre-applications through the new WCB Project Portal.

pool.quote: SB 170 allocated $100 million dollars from the state general fund to the WCB to fund projects to enhance instream flow

geography.quote: The Stream Flow Enhancement Program (SFEP) funds projects that enhance stream flows across the state of California.
